$comment: Canonical datasets the web app ETL produces and the native apps consume. The web repo is the source of truth. Use web/scripts/sync-shared-data.mjs with --consumer ios|android and --root <checkout> to sync or --check to detect drift.

directories.note: Every Town Board meeting, its fiscal-impact companion, and the index/roster files. Mirrored wholesale because a new meeting must not require editing this manifest.
Annual Financial Report datasets, mirrored as a directory so a new fiscal year does not require a manifest edit. Android only: no iOS screen reads these files.
Historical adopted-budget, budget-stage, fund-appropriation and General Fund series. iOS reads budget-stages.json for its budget, overview and tax screens; Android reads the set.
Board-authorized salary schedules and year-over-year comparisons. Android only: no iOS screen reads these files.
Fund-level adopted budget account lines and their index. Android only: no iOS screen reads these files.
The unified search index as a manifest and typed shards. Android only: the iOS app searches the published site.

files.note: Every account line of the 2027 budget as printed in the Preliminary, which the Town Board adopted unchanged on November 17, 2026 (Resolution 2026-995), with 2026 adopted beside it. iOS reads it for fund, department and account detail and the 2027 cost drivers.
Every account line of the newest Budget Supplement (2027: actuals through 2025, 2026 adopted and year-to-date, the 2027 request, Tentative and Preliminary). iOS reads it for the Line-Item Ledger.
The Budget Supplements stacked, 2020 through 2027: lines that go quiet then cost money, lines on a cycle, and renumbered accounts. iOS reads it for the Budget Accuracy watch list.
The 2027 Supplement's auto-detected outliers against the 2027 Adopted figures. iOS reads it for the Budget Accuracy watch list.
